newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka to buy 100,000 T soft and hard wheat.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka to buy 100,000 T soft and hard wheat.

text.p: Sri Lanka will buy 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat on Wednesday, an official for the government buying arm, the Co-operative Wholesale Establishment (CWE) said on Tuesday.
"We are going to close the tender tomorrow morning. The decision will be taken by evening," the official, who asked not to be named, told Reuters.

The tender is for 50,000 tonnes of soft white wheat slated for delivery during the last half of December and another 50,000 tonnes of hard red and/or spring wheat for delivery during the first half of January.
Exporters overseas said the wheat could be of U.S., Australian or Canadian origin.
